_instructions: Add a new entry for each Google Drive subfolder you create. The key must exactly match the subfolder name (lowercase). Claude uses this to write accurate, place-specific captions.

ba na.name: Ba Na Hills
ba na.description: A surreal French colonial hill station above Da Nang, wrapped in mist and clouds. Famous for the Golden Bridge held by giant stone hands, a fantasy castle, and a cable car that floats above the clouds.

da nang.name: Da Nang
da nang.description: A vibrant coastal city in central Vietnam with wide beaches, a glittering river, and incredible food. Where mountains meet the sea.

hoian.name: Hoi An
hoian.description: A UNESCO World Heritage ancient town near Da Nang, known for its lantern-lit streets, tailors, riverside cafes, and preserved trading port architecture.

son tra.name: Son Tra Peninsula
son tra.description: A wild jungle peninsula jutting into the sea just minutes from Da Nang, home to red-shanked douc langurs, hidden beaches, and panoramic ocean views.

marble mountains.name: Marble Mountains
marble mountains.description: Five marble and limestone hills rising dramatically from the flat coastline, hiding caves, Buddhist sanctuaries, and sweeping views over the sea.

hoi an.name: Hoi An
hoi an.description: A UNESCO World Heritage ancient town near Da Nang, known for its lantern-lit streets, tailors, riverside cafes, and preserved trading port architecture.

coffee/shops.name: Da Nang café culture
coffee/shops.description: Da Nang's specialty coffee scene — slow mornings, aesthetic interiors, Vietnamese drip coffee, and rooftop views. A city that takes its café culture seriously.

exploring.name: Exploring Vietnam
exploring.description: Wandering through Vietnam with no fixed plan — stumbling onto hidden alleyways, unexpected views, and the kind of moments that only happen when you slow down and look.

misc.name: Vietnam lifestyle
misc.description: Everyday life in Vietnam — the beauty in the ordinary, the chaos that becomes familiar, and the small details that make this place feel like home.

street scenes.name: Vietnamese street life
street scenes.description: The living, breathing streets of Vietnam — motorbikes weaving through traffic, vendors calling out, steam rising from bowls, and a city that never quite stops moving.

vn food.name: Vietnamese food
vn food.description: The food of Vietnam — impossibly fresh, deeply layered, and eaten everywhere from plastic stools to market halls. Pho, bánh mì, bún bò, and a thousand things you haven't tried yet.
